package.name: openswoole
package.summary: High Performance Programmatic Server for PHP with Async IO, Coroutines and Fibers
package.description: Build high-performance, scalable, concurrent TCP, UDP, Unix Socket, HTTP, WebSocket services with PHP and easy to use coroutine, fibers API.
package.notes: . PHP 8.6 support . CURLOPT_SEEKFUNCTION support in the native curl hook on PHP 8.6 . CURLOPT_PREREQFUNCTION support in the native curl hook on PHP 8.4+ (Guzzle 7.12+) . PIE (PHP Installer for Extensions) support . Response::cookie() also sends Max-Age when an expiry time is set, like setcookie() (#310) . Hooked ssl:// and tls:// client streams use the same peer verification defaults as native PHP; set verify_peer to false to connect to servers with a self-signed certificate . Cookie values are encoded and decoded like PHP does: a "+" is kept and a space is %20, in the server and the HTTP clients; cookies with spaces set by earlier versions read back with "+" until they are set again; for a cookie name sent twice, the first value is used (#311) . OpenSwoole 27.2 will require PHP 8.4 or later; 26.11 is the last release series to support PHP 8.3 . Fix stream_socket_enable_crypto with tls (#401) . Fix io_uring build on Alpine Linux (#400) . Fix SSL client certificate lost in getClientInfo() when the worker pid is greater than 65535 . Fix curl_copy_handle() not keeping the CURLOPT_STDERR stream and callback data in the native curl hook . Fix preemptive scheduler crash on ZTS builds . Fix crash in the native curl hook when a curl multi handle is released after the event loop is destroyed . Fix enable_reuse_port having no effect on Linux because SO_REUSEPORT was not detected at configure time . Fix the http2_* server settings being ignored and not sent to clients in the SETTINGS frame . Fix max_idle_time closing active connections and ignoring fractions of a second . Fix a crash when a coroutine is canceled during file I/O . Fix stream_select() closing regular files . Fix closing a unix datagram socket removing the peer's socket file . Fix process pipes never being closed . Fix Lock::lockwait() truncating the timeout . Fix process pool reload stalling, getProcess() ids and a connection leak . Fix process pool warnings about workers that already exited or detached . Fix the signal listener count with wait_signal . Fix a second Coroutine\System::waitSignal() on the same signal leaving the first waiting forever . Fix Coroutine::select() with push channels and array keys . Fix Table keys longer than 63 bytes, iteration with an empty key, and incr()/decr() on a bad column . Fix the Table row lock being taken over from a live holder . Fix an HTTP/2 RST_STREAM leaving a send_yield coroutine waiting forever . Fix the open_redis_protocol parser failing on commands split across reads and on pipelined commands . Fix hooked time_nanosleep() accepting nanoseconds out of range . Fix a crash in the native curl hook with curl_copy_handle() or connection reuse in curl_multi . Fix curl_reset() losing the coroutine state of a native curl handle . Fix co::run() not returning for minutes after curl_multi requests in the native curl hook . Fix io_uring warnings logged on every file operation when io_uring is not available, for example in Docker containers with the default seccomp profile . Fix the server master process being killed by SIGALRM when a timer was created before Server::start() . Fix the static handler sending the file body for HEAD requests . Fix the HTTP/2 client reply to PING frames and its handling of GOAWAY and padded frames . Fix CurlHandle objects never being freed with CURLOPT_HEADERFUNCTION in the native curl hook on PHP 8.4+ (#391) . Fix HTTP/2 server responses to HEAD requests sending a body . Fix bundled hiredis symbols colliding with other extensions that link hiredis (#394) . Fix the build on FreeBSD 14 and 15 (#389) . Fix OpenSwoole\Table ignoring a conflictProportion below 1 (#362) . Fix the io_uring reactor failing to start when io_uring is not available; it now falls back to epoll, and reactor_type is accepted by Server::set() (#408) . Fix HTTP/2 requests with headers split into CONTINUATION frames, and HPACK errors when http2_header_table_size is set (#388) . Fix heap corruption when closing a mysqli connection opened with mysqli_init() and real_connect() in a coroutine (#409, #378) . Fix max_request_execution_time ending later requests early and crashing workers (#315, #358) . Fix coroutines crashing when opcache.preload is enabled (#343) . Fix the deprecation warning for on('handshake') (#303) . Fix configure not finding libpq in lib64 without pg_config (#245) . Fix task workers logging a warning for SIGPIPE . Fix Xdebug not seeing the request callback with use_fiber_context, which crashed the worker when variables were inspected (#404) . Fix the io_uring reactor not answering requests in SWOOLE_PROCESS mode (#405) . Fix the io_uring reactor on kernels before 5.13, where multishot poll is not available . Various stability fixes
